issues.failure_explanation: Take μ uniform on an arc of length L. The range of U^μ over supp(μ) is the midpoint value minus the endpoint value, (2Cl(L/2)-Cl(L))/L. By item (5) of a24 this equals -2Cl(π+L/2)/L. Theorem a1's rate is (2Cl(L/2)-2Cl(π+L/2))/L, by item (8) of a24. That rate is attained at the antipodal point, which lies off the arc. The two rates differ by 2Cl(L/2)/L>0. If instead ν is uniform on the circle, ISSUE-001 applies.
